linePathForm.manageLinePathsDescription: Select a line and draw its path. Switch between lines and save them all at once.
linePathForm.helpDetailsMobile: Drag anchors to adjust them — they snap to anchors of other lines. Long-press an anchor to delete it. Tap a segment of the active line to insert an anchor.
linePathForm.helpDetailsDesktop: Drag anchors to adjust them — they snap to anchors of other lines. Right-click an anchor to delete it. Click a segment of the active line to insert an anchor.
linePathForm.drawALineWithAtLeastTwoAnch: Draw a line with at least two anchor points.
